# Minnie and Moose — complete production dialogue review

Snapshot: 2026-10-02, current working-tree production source (including pre-existing local edits). No editorial rewrites.

- **Total Minnie lines: 1233**
- **Total Moose lines: 1192**
- **Total source dialogue occurrences: 2425**
- **Review entries after conservative same-context consolidation: 2196**
- **Flagged source lines: 2171; flagged review entries: 1942**
- Coverage: 35 production levels, 120 learning challenges, 960 authored question variants traced (not dumped as a question bank), 6 shared runtime fallback lines.

## Counting and scope

World, level and context headings apply to every entry beneath them. Reference IDs identify review entries, not production IDs. Source paths and exact property paths are authoritative; numeric array indices are zero-based.

A line is one source speech-field occurrence, not a sentence, play count or unique wording. Both speakers’ hints count separately. Totals include inactive challenges, disabled production levels, legacy/shadowed guide text and runtime fallbacks so nothing available for editorial maintenance is silently discarded. Repeated text retains every exact source identifier. Review entries collapse only identical hint wording in the same level/anchor/subtype and compatible semantic context; all member source locations remain listed. Bare numeric variants can share an example, but different story nouns/settings and different spelling target words remain separate. Near-duplicate wording is flagged, never silently merged.

World ID is the root manifest level reached through connectedFrom; world name is that root’s manifest title. Level name is the definition title (these differ for e.g. ARC Atlas and De Reis door Europa). Shared runtime fallbacks are counted once in SHARED, not multiplied by every level. Narrative lines spanning multiple skills are counted in shared challenge context, with their full subtype scope and examples shown in the entry.

Excluded: developer-only LVL-0000/Cinematic FX Lab, editor.draft.json files, tests, experiments, historical reports, metadata companionFocus, cat sound assets, and prose spoken by another character or unattributed UI feedback. Only spiritLines.welcome is routed to Minnie as a compatibility fallback; other spiritLines, rune intro/solved, reward.line, answer explanations and ordinary correct/incorrect feedback are not assigned to Minnie/Moose by the current rendering path. All six runtime fallback literals are included below. No dynamic hint text generator or type-based fallback hint selector exists in current runtime: family/subtype affects authored content; currentChallengeQuestions selects a stored variant and answerQuestion reads its exact two hint fields. LVL-0018 generates moment records with challenges.map; its resolved records and their authoring origins are included.

## Flag counts and interpretation

| Category | Source lines |
| --- | ---: |
| MINNIE_MOOSE_OVERLAP | 0 |
| UNUSED_OR_UNREACHABLE | 489 |
| SHARED_ACROSS_DIFFERENT_CHALLENGE_TYPES | 256 |
| POSSIBLY_GENERIC | 258 |
| DUPLICATE_OR_NEAR_DUPLICATE | 1882 |
| POSSIBLY_TOO_REVEALING | 86 |
| POSSIBLY_WRONG_CONTEXT | 1 |

Flags overlap. DUPLICATE_OR_NEAR_DUPLICATE uses exact matching plus lower-case/punctuation/numeric normalization; it is evidence of reuse, not proof of poor dialogue. POSSIBLY_GENERIC is a conservative phrase check, not a complete editorial judgment. MINNIE_MOOSE_OVERLAP requires identical text across speakers. SHARED_ACROSS_DIFFERENT_CHALLENGE_TYPES lists exact-text reuse across subtypes or a single event’s mixed challenge scope. POSSIBLY_TOO_REVEALING identifies explicit canonical-answer text and is advisory (authoring rules permit it). POSSIBLY_WRONG_CONTEXT identifies a concrete selector/context mismatch to inspect. UNUSED_OR_UNREACHABLE is used only with code/data evidence. A world-disabled level is labeled as unavailable through the current normal world sequence, not permanently unreachable: editor preview can still load it. Flags are an initial structural screen, not a completed quality review.

## Runtime trigger and sequence contract

Source: [src/app.js](../src/app.js), especially createInitialState, guideLineForLevel, formatCompanionText, emitCompanionEvent, selectChallenge, finishInteraction, openRuneChallenge, answerQuestion, nextQuestion, renderAdventureTeamBar, renderChallenge and renderReward. World availability: [src/atlas-world.js](../src/atlas-world.js), [Levels/world-config.js](../Levels/world-config.js), [manifest](../Levels/manifest.js).

- An authored question chooses one stored variant at question start. Retries keep that variant and its choices. Wrong attempt 1 assigns Minnie; attempt 2 assigns Moose. Attempt 3+ shows the explanation and assisted completion in feedback, not a new attributed guide line. The failure counter resets on next question/reopening. Correct answers do not create new Minnie/Moose success text.
- Active:false challenges cannot be selected. requiresAllOtherChallenges gates question access. Exit readiness requires all active explicitly progressing challenges if any exist; otherwise all active challenges. Remaining blocked-exit counts use the progression-aware required set.
- Event filters match objectId and runtime rune ID (challengeId), not the selected question family. All matching moments retain array order. Immediate events (AMBIENT_ATTENTION, AMBIENT_ATTENTION_FIRST, HOTSPOT_ATTENTION_FIRST, LEVEL_PROGRESS_MILESTONE, EXIT_BLOCKED, PATH_UNLOCKED) replace the current message with their first line and replace the queue with the rest. Other events queue while moving; when stationary they preempt only if priority rises, otherwise queue. Queue advancement is user-driven/interaction-driven, not a fixed spoken timer. These rules can defer or replace authored sequences.
- Non-NPC authored challenges show hints in the team bar. NPC challenges hide that bar and show the current hint inline only on a wrong attempt with no feedback; after the third failure the feedback replaces that inline hint. CHALLENGE_OPEN lines can be stored without being visible during NPC/prerequisite panels; closing may expose the stored guide message.
- ADVENTURE_COMPLETE is emitted immediately before reward rendering, which never renders the team bar or this guide text. Non-welcome guideLines keys have no current production caller. Those entries are retained and flagged.
- Dynamic companion templates replace {completed}, {total}, {remaining}, {remainingChallenges}. Counts use context overrides or current active-rune state; remaining is clamped at zero. remainingChallenges renders Dutch singular “1 opdracht” or plural “N opdrachten”. Templates are formatted only through companion moments/fallback events, not arbitrary legacy guide strings. Each template entry includes a valid illustrative count state, not a captured play session.
